name: reglens
description: RegLens — traceable RAG-powered transaction compliance assistant (Fintech Hackathon)

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/dev.py lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.gen:types: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/dev.py openapi && npm --prefix frontend run gen:types
